hints.title: Mutable Buffer Representation
hints.text: Convert the input string into a mutable character array to execute in-place modifications.

hints.title: Sequential Command Dispatch
hints.text: Dispatch commands sequentially according to the operation type: range reversal, point replacement, or element swap.

hints.title: Resulting String Assembly
hints.text: Reassemble the character buffer into a finalized string after all operations conclude.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.notes: Direct array simulation of sequential string modification commands.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Creating new immutable string slices on every operation creates excess garbage overhead.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Single character buffer allows in-place swaps and reversals.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Implement clean in-place array manipulation without redundant copies.
